maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from selling hot dogs and food products (Branded Product Program, licensing, restaurants); consumables, not repair or maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by consumers, foodservice operators, retailers and licensees, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through licensing, foodservice product sales and franchising its brand, not through a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Hot dogs and restaurant food are commodity-like; customers can switch suppliers easily, though licensees have some brand-contract ties.
